name_en: Post-Matric Scholarship for BC, MBC and DNC College Students
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: The state pays your tuition fee and special fee (at government college rates), your full exam fee, and book money. If you stay in a college hostel, you also get Rs 4,000 a year (Rs 400 a month for 10 months) for food and stay. The money goes into your bank account.

other: Must be a native of Tamil Nadu
Must be studying ITI, polytechnic diploma, post-graduate, professional or Ph.D. course
Second-shift students in government and aided colleges can also get it

how_to_apply: Get the scholarship form from your college. Fill it in, add the papers it asks for, and give it back to your college.
where_to_apply: At your college. For questions, go to the District Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Office at the District Collectorate.

evidence.quote: Schemes for the Welfare of Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Denotified Communities
Under the scheme, tuition fee and special fee are sanctioned as fixed for the Government educational institutions.
Examination fee is sanctioned in full and book money as notified in the scholarship notification.
at the enhanced rate of Rs.4000/-per year (Rs.400/- per month for 10 months in a year) for Under Graudate courses, Professional Courses, ITI / Diploma and Post Graduate courses from the year 2021-22.
Scholarships are directly credited into the students’ bank account
Annual parental income should not exceed Rs.2.5 lakh to avail this scholarship.
Denotified Communities students studying ITI, Diploma in Polytechnics, Post Graduate, Professional and Ph.D. courses.
scholarships are sanctioned to Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Denotified Communities students
are available only to those who are natives of Tamil Nadu
Students studying in the second shift in Government and Government aided colleges are also sanctioned scholarship

BC, MBC & DNC College students can collect their BC, MBC & DNC Scholarship application from their Institutions and submit the duly filled in applications with the relevant documents to the Institutions.
For any queries contact District Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Office situated in the Campus of District Collectorate.

gaps: Source does not list the documents needed ('relevant documents' only), so documents is empty.
Source does not give the book money amount; it says 'as notified in the scholarship notification'.

Source names www.bcmbcscholarship.tn.gov.in for sanction and disbursement, but says students apply on paper at their institution; a web search snippet (not saved) mentioned umis.tn.gov.in. Current online route not confirmed.
Source page is undated (it lists 2026-2027 notices at the top, and the hostel rate is 'from the year 2021-22').
Undergraduate arts and science degree students are covered under a separate Free Education Scholarship (Degree) on the same page, not under this entry.

Doubt: the school-level BC/MBC/DNC post-matric listing on myScheme (myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pmstn) gives a BC income limit of Rs 1,00,000, while this department page gives Rs 2.5 lakh for the school-level scheme. Not used here; the department page is kept.

review.note: Official sources disagree on income limit (Rs 2.5 lakh on department page vs Rs 1 lakh on a myScheme school-level page). Department page kept.
